# InsuranceClaimsInfo.com

> The most comprehensive free resource for first-party property insurance claim information in the United States. Over 500 expert-written articles covering California insurance law, claims handling, coverage disputes, and policyholder rights.

## About

InsuranceClaimsInfo.com is operated by Leland Coontz III, a California Licensed Public Adjuster (License #2B53445) with over 20 years of experience handling property insurance claims. The site provides free educational content for policyholders, attorneys, and claims professionals.

This site is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice. Content is educational and informational.

## Key Topics

- California Fair Claims Settlement Practices Regulations (10 CCR 2695)
- Insurance policy interpretation (HO-3, HO-5, commercial property, BOP)
- Claims process guidance (filing, documentation, negotiation, settlement)
- Bad faith insurance practices and remedies under California law
- Xactimate estimating disputes and pricing analysis
- Insurance appraisal process and California case law
- Additional Living Expenses (ALE) and temporary housing
- Contents claims and personal property valuation
- Coverage disputes (exclusions, ensuing loss, efficient proximate cause)
- Types of damage (wildfire, smoke, water, mold, vandalism, hail, wind)
- Commercial insurance (business interruption, cargo, specialty)
- California Insurance Code and Department of Insurance regulations
- Elder abuse protections in insurance claims
- Special property situations (trusts, probate, divorce, reverse mortgages)

## Content Structure

- /resources — 500+ articles organized by topic
- /resources/[slug] — Individual article pages with legal citations
- /types-of-claims — Guides by damage type (fire, smoke, water, mold, etc.)
- /other-claims — Business interruption, cargo, auto damage, and more
- /regulations — California Fair Claims Regulations analysis
- /faq — Frequently asked questions
- /about — About the author and credentials
- /contact — Free claim review request
- /inventory — Personal property inventory tool
- /books — Recommended reading with reviews
